description: Renovate configuration for homelab ArgoCD GitOps cluster (manual sync required)

dependencyDashboard.title: Renovate Dashboard: ArgoCD Applications
dependencyDashboard.header:
Tracks dependency updates for the homelab Kubernetes cluster.

**After merging**: user-tier apps (apps/user/*) sync themselves; sync infra, data and services apps by hand in the [ArgoCD UI](https://argo.example.com).

---

customManagers.description: Extract versions from GitHub release URLs in Kustomize resources

Extract versions from raw GitHub URLs in Kustomize resources. Uses github-releases (NOT github-tags): the only match is argoproj/argo-cd, which publishes releases, and github-tags enumerates ALL tags (argo-cd has 500+ tag pages) — that paginated lookup is what stalled this repo's Renovate run for minutes.
Track ArgoCD image tag in kustomization.yaml images block

hostRules.description: Parallelise GitHub datasource lookups. This repo has the largest github-releases/-tags surface (kustomize + custom managers); serialised one-at-a-time requests stalled the run. matchHost must be the exact api.github.com (not github.com) and carry no hostType, per Renovate docs.

packageRules.description: Cluster updates - graduated stabilization base tier by update type (patch 1d / minor 3d / major 7d) across all apps. A short soak guards against same-day broken releases; CI catches breakage before merge and ArgoCD's manual-sync gives a deploy gate. Critical infra/data components get a longer soak via the override rule below. Security/CVE updates are exempt (vulnerabilityAlerts). The .ci/docker/Dockerfile build base keeps its own 3/7/14-day delays from the shared preset.
Cluster updates - base tier minor soak.
Cluster updates - base tier major soak.

Critical infra + shared data - longer stabilization soak (patch 3d / minor 7d / major 14d). A bad release of these has cluster-wide or data blast radius (storage, ingress, certs, LB, secrets, the shared DB/cache), so soak them longer than ordinary apps. Overrides the base tier above for these paths.
Critical infra + shared data - minor soak.
Critical infra + shared data - major soak.
Kustomize files - Disable digest pinning for all deps in kustomization.yaml (neither helmCharts nor images newTag fields support digest syntax)
Docker digest pinning - Separate by app/component directory
Application patches - Low-risk patch updates with separate MRs per app
Application Helm charts - Minor and major updates grouped by app for atomic deployments
Docker images - Container version and digest updates grouped by directory
Infrastructure Helm charts - General infra-tier components

CI Dockerfile - Build tool dependencies (helm, kustomize, kubeconform, CRDs-catalog), separate MRs per tool. Excludes docker, which is the build base handled by the dockerfile manager + the docker-ci-images group above, so it keeps its digest.

ArgoCD - Self-managing GitOps controller. Groups all argo-cd update sources into one branch: the kustomize `images: newTag` (github-releases), the `raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/...` install-manifest URL (github-releases), and any helm/docker refs. All argo-cd sources use github-releases now (the raw-URL manager was moved off github-tags to avoid paginating argo-cd's 500+ tags), so github-tags is no longer needed here. Without grouping, Renovate would create a separate `renovate/argoproj-argo-cd-3.4.x` branch racing the grouped `renovate/patch-argocd-self-update` branch.

ArgoCD - disable the built-in kustomize manager on the `images: newTag: vX.Y.Z` block. The custom.regex `Track ArgoCD image tag` manager above (depName=argoproj/argo-cd) handles this same line, and both managers want to apply the same vX.Y.Z → vX.Y.Z+1 transition into the same branch (grouped via argocd-self-update). The custom.regex commits first; the built-in kustomize manager then logs 'Cannot find replaceString' because v3.4.2 is no longer in the file. Disabling it here keeps a single source of truth for that line.
Longhorn - Distributed storage system
Traefik - Ingress controller, affects entire cluster network access
Cert-Manager - TLS certificate automation
MetalLB - L2 load balancer for bare metal cluster

PostgreSQL chart (vendored: the postUpgradeTask pulls the new chart into apps/data/postgresql/charts/ and removes the old copy, so the MR passes validate:apps as opened) - shared database for multiple apps. OCI helmCharts entries are extracted with the DOCKER datasource and the full registry path as package name (the old helm-datasource + bare 'postgresql' match dies silently against oci:// repos).

Valkey chart (vendored: the postUpgradeTask pulls the new chart into apps/data/valkey/charts/ and removes the old copy, so the MR passes validate:apps as opened) - shared cache/state for multiple apps. OCI helmCharts entries are extracted with the DOCKER datasource and the full registry path as package name (the old helm-datasource + bare 'valkey' match dies silently against oci:// repos).
